Like Bye-Words (sic note different spelling), a collection of stories earlier printed elsewhere: ‘The price of blood’, ‘The cat of Cat Copse’, ‘De facto and de jure’, ‘Sigbert\'s Guerdon’, ‘The beggar\'s legacy’, ‘A review of nieces’, ‘Come to her kingdom’, ‘Mrs. Batseyes’, and ‘Chops’.
